notes.title: New Console Available - PlayStation 5 🔵
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pet Hoteliers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to announce that [b]Pets Hotel[/b] is now available on [b]PlayStation 5! 😍[/b][/h3]

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013088


[h3]At Pets Hotel, each animal has its own unique needs that you must meet to ensure a happy stay. Your job will be to feed, care for and provide appropriate entertainment. A satisfied customer is the best business strategy![/h3]

[h3][b]Become an owner of your own pets hotel on console and embark on this amazing animal-filled adventure now on PlayStation 5! 😽[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=8GfuYIw_9Ew;full][/previewyoutube]
Have fun!
Pets Hotel Team

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Interaction with items is more flexible. There will no longer be a situation where an interaction failed notification is shown when trying to fill a bowl
[*] You can no longer interact with items through the wall
[*] Playing with the cat has been simplified a bit. Cat jumps on the feathers more slowly
[*] Fixed picking up newspapers lying on the floor. You don't have to destroy the floor to pick up the newspapers
[*] Improved employee interaction with the microwave. Employee should no longer get stuck when trying to interact with the microwave
[*] Animal needs don't increase so much with change of day
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with textures that caused the performance to drop to 1 fps on some devices
- Made partial corrections to translations
- Reduced the size of the game on disk
- Customers first come to pick up pets and then hand them over so that swaping animals to the same room on the same day can be possible
- Added light volumetric mist
- Disabled next tutorial button in last tutorial

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] During free play, a tooltip on how to open the tablet is displayed all the time
[*] In buy walls, floor or roof mode with the camera from above enabled, you can change floors with the PageUp and PageDown keys
[*] Temporarily disabled step simulation on the camera, the camera will not move up and down
[*] You can place rooms on grass, but they will still require a floor to function
[*] Lamps saves that they are on or off and will remain so after loading the game
[*] Dog should no longer stop behind a wall when the player interacts with the tub faster than the dog on leash can reach the player
[*] A notification appears if the player tries to assign a function to a key that is already assigned to another function
[/list]

Thank you very much to everyone for suggestions and reporting bugs, thanks to you the game can be better and better :)

[/list]

notes.title: Massaging the Hotel attenders😺
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pets Hotel Owners![/b] 🐶[/h1]
Today we are gonna go over the [b]massage[/b] service you will be able to provide for your favorite animals!🐢❤

[h1][b]Massage[/b]🥰[/h1]
[b]Masseuses[/b] need to be called in to their [b]stations[/b] every time there is a job for them📞

Items used only by your workers will be marked accordingly in the shop🎀

If you have 10 [b]pets[/b] and 6 of them have to be [b]massaged[/b] you will need to call a specialist for the job to take care of the [b]pets[/b] one by one.👩‍🏫

Everything to make your [b]pets[/b] feel loved and cared for🥰

[h1][b]Special service[/b]💅🏻[/h1]
When the client calls there is going to be a window that will appear, informing you about the details of an animal and displaying an additional service like a [b]massage[/b]🙀 that the client may want to be performed.🤳

If the player bought [b]equipment[/b] letting him do that service he can accept the [b]pet[/b].💲✅

For the special [b]service[/b] you have to buy [b]special equipment[/b] and set it up in its designated place.👨‍🏫

We hope you will have a lot of fun with these special services added to the game! Let us know what you think about it in our [b]Discord[/b]! (link below) Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get the freshest [b]devlogs[/b] delivered right under your doorstep!  ✨

[url=https://discord.gg/SC9YtyErJX][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034904/ee382ff33504d56841598b8a69ea5770a101be7f.png[/img][/url]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/

Massage you soon!
The Pets Hotel Team
